model_annotation: This diagonally rotated grouped bar chart illustrates the "effect" across various language families for six distinct models or configurations. The chart's internal horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "family," ordered from left to right as IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The internal vertical axis represents the numeric value of the "effect" on a linear scale, featuring horizontal grid lines and tick labels at intervals of 10, ranging from 0 to 30, with the axis extending slightly below zero to accommodate negative values. Within each language family category on the horizontal axis, up to six vertical bars are grouped side-by-side. According to the legend, these bars correspond to mBERT-L2 (light blue), XLM-L2 (dark blue), mBERT-R2 (light green), XLM-R2 (dark green), mBERT-B2 (light pink), and XLM-B2 (dark red). Every individual bar includes a black, vertical error bar extending upwards and downwards from its top edge to indicate variance. The represented effect values vary widely across the chart; the tallest bars are found in the IE-Indic group, where the mBERT-B2 (light pink) bar reaches an approximate value of 18, while its upper error bar approaches 30. Conversely, the lowest values occur where bars extend below the zero line, such as the light and dark green bars in the Semitic group, and the light and dark blue bars in the Isolate group. The horizontal axis categories are generally grouped by the "IE-" prefix rather than following a strict alphabetical sort, and aside from the overall diagonal tilt of the entire graph, no specific bars are given distinct visual emphasis beyond their assigned legend colors.
